svg.aria-label: ESM-2 t33 encoder, all 33 layers frozen. Features are tapped at layer 12, pooled over the epitope residues, concatenated with 20 geometry descriptors, and passed to a gradient-boosted head. No parameter inside the encoder is trained; layers 13 to 33 never contribute.
svg.text: A frozen encoder and a trained head
ESM-2 t33 has 33 encoder layers. None of them are trained. Representations are read out at layer 12 and only the head is fitted.
649,400,981 encoder parameters · 0 trained · tap at layer 12 of 33
Layer 12 was chosen by a sweep, but layers 12 and 33 differ by 0.003 AUC, inside noise. The depth of the tap matters less than tapping at all.
